lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.purpose: While track or walk recording is active and the app UI is hidden, keep a fixed 10-second alarm-stream heartbeat as long as the shared GNSS stream supplies fresh validated measurements before point decimation, including unchanged stationary coordinates. Notification volume does not suppress it; zero or muted alarm volume selects short vibration, including a distinct double vibration for a throttled persistence failure. Silence all feedback when delivery stops or the setting is disabled. This switch does not own or disable the GPS recording wake lock.
